nodes.label: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) - 2026
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf
nodes.rationale: ~2-hour curriculum for an end-to-end chat system querying multiple structured databases plus a separate RAG path for unstructured data.

nodes.label: Router (database routing)
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf
nodes.rationale: Decide which DB(s) to query per question via keyword heuristics/LLM classification, schema-embedding similarity (MDB-Link) or agentic exploration; a simple mapping/classifier is often enough.

nodes.label: Schema Injector
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf
nodes.rationale: Inject only the relevant schema into the LLM context to reduce prompt size and stay within context limits.

nodes.label: Query Generator (LLM SQL writer)
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf

nodes.label: SQL Executor (read-only)
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf

nodes.label: Self-Correction retry loop
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf
nodes.rationale: On syntax error or empty result, feed the error back to the LLM and retry up to ~3 times.

nodes.label: Result Synthesizer
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf

nodes.label: Response Formatter
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf

nodes.label: RAG path for unstructured data
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf
nodes.rationale: Unstructured questions are vectorized and answered from retrieved chunks with citations; hybrid questions may use both SQL and RAG paths.

nodes.label: Data Federation
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf
nodes.rationale: Query live data in place without copying; fresh and no duplication, but unpredictable performance and complex cross-system security.

nodes.label: Data Virtualization
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf

nodes.label: ETL/ELT centralization
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf
nodes.rationale: Consolidate into a warehouse for speed and simpler governance at the cost of staleness, storage and pipeline maintenance.

nodes.label: Semantic / Metrics Layer
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf
nodes.rationale: Central definitions of business metrics (e.g. revenue) so joins and formulas stay consistent and the agent does not reinvent meanings.

nodes.label: Federated Query Engines (Trino/Starburst, Presto, Dremio, Denodo)
nodes.source_file: Building a Multi-Database Chatbot (Structured Data Query + RAG) – 2026.pdf

nodes.rationale: Start federated for each new source, materialize heavily-queried datasets; compliance (data residency) may force federation only.
